decision.fail: Any mismatch, timeout, absent activation receipt, busy queued call, missing release witness, or uncertain cleanup is FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN. Phase 2 does not run unless the full strict phase-1 gate passes.
decision.pass: Phase 1 passes every frozen strict release criterion, including one dispatch/cancel, held Q-up, 21 same-call polls, independent same-generation Q-up witness and bounded cleanup; then phase 2 separately passes fresh-generation action effect and oracle receipt checks.
decision.stop: One paired attempt only, one dispatch and at most one public cancel, no retry/replay. The activation gate is bounded to 120 seconds and fails closed.

resource_boundary: One native Windows PC; one owned fixture per phase, at most one paired sequence, one phase-1 dispatch, at most one phase-1 public cancel, no replay/retry. Each phase requires CUA activation marker and independent exact foreground HWND readback. Phase 2 begins only after the full strict phase-1 gate. No WSLc/Docker.
retry_policy: Input-free hash/preflight, then one fixture/dispatch and at most one cancellation attempt. Both phases require exact CUA activation marker and independent foreground HWND readback before API calls. On any mismatch or timeout, preserve evidence and never retry.

scope.environment: Native Win32 supervised caller on the user-authorized local Windows PC. No WSLc or Docker allocation is claimed or used.
phase_order: phase 1 one fresh fixture/observation/validation/dispatch/cancel; apply existing strict R36 gate
close phase-1 hook, session and fixture; only if strict gate passes, continue
phase 2 one new fixture/process/window and standard MCP session; observe, validate, dispatch once, retrieve the exact result read-only if pending, verify once with independent server-side oracle
no retry, replay or third phase
scope.question: Does exact CUA activation of the unique owned fixture, with foreground HWND readback before any API observation/dispatch, change the R41 queued-before-backend result and permit bounded release followed by a separately gated fresh-generation task-oracle success?
scope.reliability: single paired sequence; no reliability estimate
scope.stop: If phase 1 is not STRICT_RELEASE_PASS, do not start phase 2. Preserve all evidence. Any phase-2 mismatch, timeout, duplicate attempt, stale generation, wrong effect, oracle mismatch, or cleanup uncertainty is FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN; never retry.
